principle: Venue operating information should come from the venue owner or management company wherever available.
rules: Shop-specific hours always override venue hours.
Food-court hours override general mall hours for food-court tenants.
Venue hours are fallback context and must not be labelled as confirmed shop hours.
Night-market and late-night venues may use cross-midnight schedules.
A closed venue may down-rank enclosed tenants, but independent-entrance exceptions remain eligible.
Do not guess missing hours. Display 未有提供 when neither shop nor venue hours are known.

Automated collection from an official website must respect that site's access and reuse terms; otherwise store the official source reference and verified factual venue schedule through an allowed workflow.
